title: Advanced HTML Viewer
description: Marks and notes on HTML files, stored in the file itself.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Apply changes made to the file outside JupyterLab to the open page, without a reload. Off, the file is read only when you reload the page or the viewer writes a mark, a note, the panel state or the trust, and the page then shows any change it holds; marks and notes still work.

animation.title: Animate changes
animation.description: Type added text in letter by letter and delete removed text from its end. Off, a change appears at once.

highlight.title: Highlight changes
highlight.description: Show added text on a green background and removed text on a red one.

author.title: Note handle
author.description: The handle written on every note line you add, without the leading @. Empty writes @user, and you are asked for a handle the first time you write a note. Set note handle in the command palette puts the same question again.

tabCue.title: Tab marker
tabCue.description: Show a marker on the tab of a file that changes on disk: a half circle whose filled half swaps sides while changes arrive, and a dot in the theme's brand colour 2 for changes that arrived while the tab was behind another. Off shows no marker.

trustedHistory.title: Let a trusted page change its address
trustedHistory.description: On a trusted page, its scripts may change the part of the address after # (history.pushState, history.replaceState), as slide decks do to record the slide. Off leaves the browser's refusal. An untrusted page runs no scripts, so the setting does nothing there.
